text: Read WORKSPACE.md in /workspace and follow it exactly. Implement this phase according to the instructions in inputs/, working only inside candidate/. Everything you may use is in this workspace: there is no internet, and nothing outside it is yours to read. Before you finish, run all four package gates inside candidate/: pnpm test, pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint, and pnpm build, and fix any failures. When you are done, report a brief summary of what you implemented and the result of each gate.
